attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Brine Coast League's holdouts burned a ferry on the south channel","reason":"The briefing says the Black Fen Raiders burned the ferry, not the Brine Coast League."},{"span":"leaving the southern route impassable for any incoming trade","reason":"The briefing gives no consequence for trade or route access."},{"span":"formally ceased all operations toward Lowmere","reason":"The briefing says only that it stopped sending reporters, not all operations."},{"span":"citing an inability to verify security protocols within the colony","reason":"The briefing gives no reason for the decision."},{"span":"our resident correspondent","reason":"Quell's role or posting is not stated."},{"span":"no word from him has been received over the past week","reason":"The time span is invented."}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It wrongly blames the ferry burning on the Brine Coast League instead of the Black Fen Raiders, and it invents several further details. It also opens by copying the briefing heading, has no dry or wry voice, uses office jargon like 'security protocols', and falls short of 80 words."}
